decision_rule.PAIR_OBSERVER_QUOTIENT_CERTIFIED_NO_ADDE: All public pair-context fibres are single-valued and the public-carrier partition equals the operational target kernel. Certify no added read on the frozen pair observer and unlock S3 preregistration.
decision_rule.PAIR_OBSERVER_QUOTIENT_NOT_CERTIFIED: Any public fibre splits, representative count is incomplete, S1 evidence binding fails, or public-carrier and target-kernel partitions disagree. Stop for review; do not invent a descriptor post hoc.
decision_rule.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Any authority, evidence, observer, or execution mismatch.

question: On the complete frozen G5:S1 pair census, does the operational pair observer factor exactly through the inherited G4 public carrier state CAPS7 + H-class bag with no additional read?

quotient_rule.exact_congruence_gate: Every one of the 124 public pair-context keys must have exactly four exact representative pairs and exactly one observer value.
quotient_rule.hidden_topology_usage: Diagnostic only after quotient construction; never enters a quotient key.
quotient_rule.observer_kernel_gate: On the four-carrier frozen domain, the public carrier partition must equal the complete target-behavior kernel induced by all public context classes and all 31 operators.
quotient_rule.observer_value: complete S1 public_signature = legal_realization_count + attempted_owner_pairs + public outcome multiset
quotient_rule.public_carrier_key: exact G4 public read = CAPS7 + H-class bag; no hidden fields
quotient_rule.public_pair_context_key: (left public carrier key, right public carrier key, directed frozen G4 operator)
